Container.Name: OpenBot
Container.Overview: OpenBot is a local-first workspace for persistent AI teammates (Codex, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor CLI, Cline, etc.). Run agents with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration. After starting the container, sign in using the Unraid WebGUI Terminal: docker exec -it openbot openbot login Then manage and chat with your agents at https://openbot.run/app or via the desktop/mobile apps.
Container.Changes: [b]Automated Daily Build[/b] - Based on upstream nightly-labs/openbot releases - Headless container server runtime with virtual X11 displays - Multi-arch support (linux/amd64 and linux/arm64)

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory on Unraid for OpenBot agents, workspaces, configurations, and databases.

Config.Name: Virtual Display Size
Config.Description: Virtual display resolution used for embedded agent browser tasks (default: 1280x800).
